_comment: Rule-delivery eval scenarios. Each is a real failure from the 2026-09-26 rule-delivery audit (Neotoma analysis ent_b66293f0dcc8c887d4fdbeae), rebuilt in a sandbox: files live in the run directory and Neotoma is the fixture MCP server. The outcome is judged from the fixture's call log and the run directory's files, never from the model's own account.
